title: My Own Song

sections.name: Listen
lines: I can play a song I know,
But I can make one too,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Every note is like a toy,

sections.name: Together
lines: Play with me, the song we know,
Then we'll make a new one,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Now it's your turn, make it up,
Fast or slow or high or low,

lyrics:
[Listen]
I can play a song I know,
Note by note, just so.
But I can make one too,
Something brand new.

[Listen again]
Every note is like a toy,
Pick it up and play.
Put them in an order,
Any kind of way.

[Together]
Play with me, the song we know,
C and E and G.
Then we'll make a new one,
Wait and see.

[One more verse]
Now it's your turn, make it up,
Any note you choose.
Fast or slow or high or low,
There's nothing you can lose.

[All together]
That was your own song,
No one else's, yours.
Play it again tomorrow,
Open all the doors.

title: Echo Me, Then You

sections.name: Listen again
lines: I play first, then you play,

sections.name: Together
lines: Play with me, same as me,
Now it's time to swap it round,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Now you play and I will listen,
I will be the echo now,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Echo me, echo me,
Play it back to me.
Echo me, echo me,
Easy as can be.

[Listen again]
I play first, then you play,
Just the same as mine.
Echo, echo, back again,
Everything is fine.

[Together]
Play with me, same as me,
Echo, one, two, three.
Now it's time to swap it round,
You lead me.

[One more verse]
Now you play and I will listen,
Make up something new.
I will be the echo now,
Echoing for you.

[All together]
Echo me, echo you,
Back and forth we play.
Your tune and my tune,
Hip hip hooray!

title: Painting with Notes

sections.name: Listen
lines: Red is low and yellow's high,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Splash a note, a little dot,

sections.name: Together
lines: Paint with me, red and blue,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Now your turn, the page is blank,
Spots and swirls and zig-zag lines,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Red is low and yellow's high,
Blue is in between.
Painting with my music,
Prettiest you've seen.

[Listen again]
Splash a note, a little dot,
Swish a long one, wide.
Every note's a colour,
Paint it, side by side.

[Together]
Paint with me, red and blue,
Yellow, green and pink.
Every note's a colour,
What do you think?

[One more verse]
Now your turn, the page is blank,
Paint it how you like.
Spots and swirls and zig-zag lines,
Notes that sparkle bright.

[All together]
Look at our big painting,
Hanging on the wall.
Painted all with music,
Best of all.

title: Robot Beeps

sections.name: Listen
lines: Robot plays the notes I give,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Press a button, beep, beep, beep,

sections.name: Together
lines: Low and high and in between,

sections.name: All together
lines: Thank you for the robot song,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Beep, beep, robot friend,
Beep, beep, boop.
Robot plays the notes I give,
In a little loop.

[Listen again]
Press a button, beep, beep, beep,
Robot starts to dance.
Every note's a new command,
Give the bot a chance.

[Together]
Beep with me, robot friend,
Beep, beep, boop, beep.
Low and high and in between,
Beep, beep, beep.

[One more verse]
Now you program robot songs,
Any notes you choose.
Robot copies all you play,
Robot cannot lose.

[All together]
Beep, beep, robot friend,
Powering down now.
Thank you for the robot song,
Robot takes a bow.

title: Rain Made Up
lyrics:
[Listen]
Drip, drop, rain,
On the pane.
Every drop,
Plays a game.

[Listen again]
Big drops, low,
Small drops, high.
Rain makes songs,
From the sky.

[Together]
Rain with me,
One, two, three.
Drip and drop,
Plip, plop, plee.

[One more verse]
Now you rain,
Your own way.
Any drops,
You can play.

[All together]
Rain stops now,
Sun comes through.
Rain song made,
Just by you.

title: Story Song

sections.name: Listen
lines: Once upon a time there was
It went walking, step by step,
To find its friends, you see.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: D was waiting by the door,

sections.name: Together
lines: Walk with me, the three of us,
Then the story's up to you,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Now you tell the story, too,
Do they run or do they hide?

sections.name: All together
lines: The end, the end, the very end,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Once upon a time there was
A little note called C.
It went walking, step by step,
To find its friends, you see.

[Listen again]
D was waiting by the door,
E was by the tree.
Walking, walking, all of them,
C and D and E.

[Together]
Walk with me, the three of us,
C and D and E.
Then the story's up to you,
What happens? Let's see!

[One more verse]
Now you tell the story, too,
With the notes you know.
Do they run or do they hide?
You choose where they go.

[All together]
And the notes lived happily
In a song so bright.
The end, the end, the very end,
Story song goodnight.

title: Animal Sounds, My Way

sections.name: Listen
lines: Lion's low and bird is high,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Cat goes somewhere in the middle,

sections.name: Together
lines: Play with me, low and high,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Stomp or squeak or hop or slide,

sections.name: All together
lines: And the best one of them all

lyrics:
[Listen]
Lion's low and bird is high,
Frog is in between.
Every animal's a note,
Funniest you've seen.

[Listen again]
Elephant goes stomp, stomp, low,
Mouse goes squeak up high.
Cat goes somewhere in the middle,
Purring like a sigh.

[Together]
Play with me, low and high,
Lion, frog and bird.
Every animal sings along,
Have you heard?

[One more verse]
Now make up your animal,
What sound will it make?
Stomp or squeak or hop or slide,
Any sound you'd make.

[All together]
All the animals sang today,
Big ones, small ones, too.
And the best one of them all
Was the one by you.

title: Dream Tune

sections.name: Listen
lines: Close your eyes and dream a tune,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: In my dream the stars all sing,

sections.name: Together
lines: Dream with me, slow and soft,
Then you'll dream your very own,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Now play the tune inside your dream,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Close your eyes and dream a tune,
Floating like a cloud.
Softly, softly, dream it up,
Not too loud.

[Listen again]
In my dream the stars all sing,
Moon hums low and deep.
Every dream has music,
Even when I sleep.

[Together]
Dream with me, slow and soft,
Floating up aloft.
Then you'll dream your very own,
Soft, soft, soft.

[One more verse]
Now play the tune inside your dream,
Gently, as you like.
Slow and soft and sleepy,
Like a floating kite.

[All together]
Dream tune, dream tune,
Hold it, keep it near.
In the morning, play it,
It'll still be here.

title: Everyone's a Composer

sections.name: Listen
lines: Make a tune, a brand-new tune,

sections.name: Together
lines: Play with me, the final song,
Then the stage is all for you,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Now's your chance, the biggest one,
Play it loud or play it soft,

sections.name: All together
lines: You made up your very own,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Everyone's a composer,
Everyone can play.
Make a tune, a brand-new tune,
Every single day.

[Listen again]
Grown-ups write the big songs,
Children write them, too.
Every song that's ever been
Started out brand new.

[Together]
Play with me, the final song,
C and E and G.
Then the stage is all for you,
One, two, three!

[One more verse]
Now's your chance, the biggest one,
Make your very best.
Play it loud or play it soft,
Any way is best.

[All together]
Everyone's a composer,
Take a great big bow.
You made up your very own,
Composer, you, right now!
